_comment: Design Structure Matrix settings. The application URL and repositories are set by qam setup --url / --source (never pre-set). Sign-in details never go here: use the terminal prompt or the QA project's git-ignored .env.

login._comment: mode: auto = sign in on a detected sign-in page (the two variables named by username_env and password_env, from the environment or the QA project's .env; qam setup names them <APP>_USER and <APP>_PASSWORD; else asked in a terminal); manual = sign in yourself in a visible browser; none = no sign-in, only the signed-out pass. save_session keeps the session in dsm/.auth/state.json (owner-only, git-ignored); set it to false to sign in every time. signed_out_pass: crawl signed out first (writes blocked, nothing submitted) and merge it with the signed-in crawl, so the public screens (sign-in, sign-up) get their fields and every screen records who can see it (public, signed-in, both); false crawls only signed in.

crawl._comment: concurrency: pages crawled at once, in tabs of one browser session (writes still blocked); 1 crawls one page at a time. settle_ms above is now only the longest a page may keep changing before it counts as settled.

safety._comment: After sign-in every write request to any host is blocked, so the crawl cannot change data. Add read-only POST endpoints (such as a search API) to allow_mutating_patterns only if a page needs them to render.
